Description: As a Member, I want to register any number of content sources (blog RSS, web page with no RSS, podcast RSS, YouTube channel, events feed) mapped to categories, so that my content is pulled onto the site automatically.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Add, edit, pause, delete feed records from profile and the Submit Content page
- Each record has type, URL/identifier, target categories, full-text toggle
- YouTube record accepts a UC channel ID or URL; invalid ID rejected clearly
- Web-page (no RSS) record accepts a listing-page URL
- Only Contributor-and-above can manage feeds

Description: As a Site Admin, I want the system to check one member's feeds every 5 minutes in rotation, so that new content appears promptly without overloading any source.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Scheduled task runs every 5 minutes and advances to the next member
- Rotation pointer persists and wraps all eligible members
- Interval configurable; changing it reschedules the task
- Schedule self-heals if the event is lost

Description: As a Member, I want new items imported with their original title, image, full text, and date under my name, so that my work is represented accurately and credited.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Keeps original title, sideloaded image, body, date; authored by the member
- Ends with source link and republished-with-permission note; canonical to original
- Lands in the feed record's categories
- Up to 5 new items per feed per run (configurable)
- YouTube Shorts skipped

Description: As a Site Admin, I want imported items matched against existing content by identifier and title, so that six years of existing posts are never duplicated.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Item present by GUID or matching title is not re-imported
- Legacy post matched by title gets the GUID stamped on
- De-dup considers trashed items so removed imports don't return

Title 3: US-005 Backfill history on first fetch
Description: As a Member, I want my full back-catalogue imported the first time a feed is checked, so that my existing content is available immediately.
Acceptance Criteria:
- First fetch imports full history, uncapped by the per-run limit
- Social sharing and push suppressed during backfill
- Admin can Run historic per feed and Run all historic (no social)

Description: As a Member whose feed only carries summaries or has no feed, I want the system to fetch the full article, so that the complete post is republished.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Full-text toggle fetches the article page and extracts the full body when more complete
- No-RSS source discovers new links from a listing page and scrapes each article
- Outbound fetches of member URLs blocked from private/internal addresses

Description: As a Site Admin, I want a category's image used when an imported post has none, so that every card has a picture.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Featured image resolves: item image, then first content image, then category image, then none
- Category image set per category, downloaded once and reused

Description: As a Site Admin, I want an email after a feed fails several times, so that I can fix broken sources.
Acceptance Criteria:
- After 5 consecutive failures the admin is emailed with feed and last error
- Other feeds unaffected
- Failing feeds listed on the dashboard, worst first

Description: As a Visitor, I want events, podcasts, and videos as their own content types with appropriate layouts, so that each reads the way it should.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Own archives at /events/, /podcasts/, /videos/
- Blog full article; video title+embed+description; podcast player+notes; event name/date/location/organiser/actions
- Events archive lists upcoming first, past after
- Privacy-friendly video embeds; podcast duration shown

Description: As a Site Admin, I want an 8-slot home page where each slot is a chosen component with its own filters, so that I control the front page without code.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Each of 8 slots assignable: news block, YouTube slider, popular, podcast slider, events calendar, post blocks
- Every component supports category include/exclude, date window, author include/exclude, counts
- Sliders play in place; empty items skipped
- Fully responsive

Description: As a Visitor, I want a sticky sidebar with an events calendar, advert, social buttons, and coffee link, so that I can explore and support the community.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Monthly events calendar with linked event days and month navigation
- Configurable advert (image+link or HTML) marked sponsored
- Three social buttons and coffee link configurable; one master toggle

Title 3: US-012 Submit a content source (front end)
Description: As a Member, I want a front-end page to add a source by choosing type, categories, and a URL, so that I can contribute without the admin area.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Logged-out visitors see a styled log-in/register prompt
- URL label/placeholder/help change with the selected type
- Submitting adds a feed record and lists existing sources with status

Title 3: US-013 Write a post on the site with approval
Description: As a Member without a blog, I want to write a post that goes for admin approval, so that I can contribute original content.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Front-end editor: title, rich-text body, categories, optional image (images only)
- Saved as pending; admin emailed a review link
- Empty/whitespace-only submissions rejected
- On approval behaves like any post; no source attribution or redirect

Title 3: US-014 Manage my profile and author page (front end)
Description: As a Member, I want to manage my name, bio, photos, links, and author-page sections, so that I control my public presence.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Front-end My Account edits the same fields as admin via the same validated save
- Toggle blog/podcast/video/event/links/bio sections and digest preference
- Profile photo replaces the default avatar site-wide

Title 3: US-015 Branded sign-in, registration, and reset
Description: As a Visitor, I want the login, registration, and password screens styled to the site, so that joining feels part of the brand.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Login/registration/lost-password use the site colours and logo
- Button and field colours stay readable under any palette
- Self-registration enable-able with a default publishing role

Description: As a Member, I want to see my content's view stats, so that I know how my posts perform.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Views counted per post (all-time and per month)
- Profile shows views this month, all-time, published count, top 3 read

Title 3: US-017 Mark a post as paid at a tier
Description: As a Site Admin, I want to mark a post paid at a standard or featured tier with configurable prices, so that I can monetise placement.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Standard (default GBP 25) or Featured (default GBP 100); prices configurable
- Featured joins the featured category and leaves after configurable days (default 7); paid status remains
- Downgrading Featured to Standard removes featured placement immediately

Description: As a Visitor, I want paid content clearly labelled, so that I know when placement was paid for.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Paid post shows a Paid content badge over its image everywhere and a banner when opened
- Disclosure cannot be removed by configuration and persists after the featured window
- Badge and banner appear in the app too

Description: As a Site Admin, I want a per-post PayPal link and a way to record receipt, so that I can invoice and track sponsors.
Acceptance Criteria:
- With a PayPal email set, each paid post shows a correct-amount link tagged with the post ID
- Payment-received control records the date; posts list shows tier, featured-until, outstanding indicator

Title 3: US-020 Auto-share new content to social accounts
Description: As a Site Admin, I want new content announced on LinkedIn, Bluesky, Mastodon, and X, so that it reaches followers automatically.
Acceptance Criteria:
- On publish (not backfill) an announcement queues per enabled network with title/handle/excerpt/link/hashtags/image
- Templates editable per type and network; shared once per network with retries
- Members credited by @handle when profile links provide one
- Credentials admin-only and stored securely

Title 3: US-021 Welcome email on first post
Description: As a Member, I want a welcome email when my first content goes live, so that I feel acknowledged and learn the site.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Sent once ever when a member's first item publishes
- Editable subject/body with placeholders; can be disabled

Description: As a Subscriber, I want a weekly digest of the best new content, so that I keep up without visiting daily.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Top 4 blogs, top video, top podcast, newest event; never repeats sent items
- Recipients: members not opted out plus confirmed subscribers; one-click unsubscribe
- Custom HTML template supported; quiet weeks skipped

Title 3: US-023 Website subscribe with double opt-in
Description: As a Visitor, I want to subscribe on the website and confirm by email, so that only I can add my address.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Spam-protected, rate-limited form sends a confirmation email; only confirmed get the digest
- Response never reveals whether an address is already subscribed
- Admins see confirmed vs pending counts

Description: As a Site Admin, I want to send email through authenticated SMTP, so that digests reach inboxes not spam.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Host/port/encryption/auth/from configurable; password stored securely and never shown
- When enabled all site email uses SMTP; when disabled default mail is used

Description: As an App User, I want to browse blogs, events, podcasts, and videos, so that I can read the community on my phone.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Four tabs with pull-to-refresh and infinite scroll
- Item shows image, type, date, title, excerpt, author; paid items disclosed
- Targets Android 8.0+

Title 3: US-026 Sign in and follow categories
Description: As an App User, I want to sign in and choose followed categories, so that my feed and downloads match my interests.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Sign-in via WordPress username + application password over HTTPS; stored in secure store
- Signed-in see followed categories; anonymous see last 5 days of everything
- Preferences saved to the member's profile via the API

Description: As an App User, I want to keep the latest items offline with a size I choose, so that I can read with no signal.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Latest N per section (10/25/50/100/200) kept locally and shown offline
- Lowering the limit trims stored items; a control clears offline content

Title 3: US-028 Native reader and external media
Description: As an App User, I want posts to read natively and media to open in the right app, so that reading is fast and playback is best.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Title, image, body render natively; source links open the original
- Podcasts and videos open externally (browser/YouTube/podcast app)
- Events show date, location, tickets action

Title 3: US-029 Search and save in the app
Description: As an App User, I want to search all content and save items, so that I can find and keep what matters.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Search queries all four types, merged newest-first
- Any item saved to a local list that survives clearing the offline cache

Title 3: US-030 Push notifications for new content
Description: As an App User, I want a notification when new content lands in my categories, so that I don't miss it.
Acceptance Criteria:
- New content pushes to a general topic and the post's category topics; imports never notify
- Category followers notified for those; general topic can be turned off
- Admin configures push securely and can send a test

Description: As a Site Admin, I want to set logos, a six-colour palette, and fonts, so that the site matches our brand without code.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Website logo and header sponsor (label, logo, link) uploadable
- Six roles configurable: primary, secondary, tertiary, hyperlink, hyperlink-visited, background; other colours derive and stay accessible
- Font family and base size selectable; defaults meet contrast

Title 3: US-032 Site search across all content types
Description: As a Visitor, I want to search the site and find blogs, events, podcasts, and videos, so that I can locate content quickly.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Header search control reveals a field; results render as cards with pagination
- Search covers all four content types
- Standalone events calendar available as a shortcode

Description: As a Site Admin, I want widgets for top posters, failing feeds, and unverified members, so that I can manage the community.
Acceptance Criteria: - Top 10 posters this month, failing feeds worst-first, members never logged in or updated

Title 3: US-034 Redirect syndicated posts to the original
Description: As a Site Admin, I want visitors on a syndicated blog post redirected to the author's site after the view is counted, so that authors get their traffic.
Acceptance Criteria: - Syndicated blog posts redirect to the original; view counted first; editors/previews/override exempt; toggleable

Description: As a Site Admin, I want old low-view imports binned, so that the site stays fresh.
Acceptance Criteria: - Daily: imported content older than configured years with fewer than configured views is binned (default 3y/50); capped, recoverable, never manual content; toggleable

Description: As a Site Admin, I want a dismissible cookie banner linking to our policy, so that we meet consent expectations.
Acceptance Criteria: - Configurable banner (enable, text, policy-page link) shows once, remembered per device, accessible

Title 3: US-037 Clean install, upgrade, and uninstall
Description: As a Site Admin, I want the platform to install, upgrade, and uninstall cleanly, so that operations are safe.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Activation creates tables, pages, types, schedules with no errors; schema upgrades preserve data
- Uninstall removes settings/tables/user syndication data but keeps imported content and media
- Secrets not autoloaded and never exposed via the settings API

Description: As a Site Admin, I want a documented install/config/go-live/rollback procedure with a staging checklist, so that I can launch confidently.
Acceptance Criteria:
- Runbook covers install, config, SMTP/DNS, app+push bootstrap, staging checklist, go-live, rollback
- Platform verified on a staging copy of live content before production
